user.title: Smarter Dumb Washer
user.description: Select the plug power sensor and the washer door sensor.

data_description.power_sensor: Smart plug power entity, in watts
data_description.start_power_threshold: A cycle starts when average power over 20 seconds reaches this value, or 20 W if this is lower
data_description.idle_power_threshold: Power below this value can end a cycle. Must be below the start threshold
data_description.end_delay: How long power must stay idle before the cycle ends
data_description.door_closed_start: A cycle starts only while the door is closed

error.same_entity: Power sensor and door sensor must be different entities.
error.idle_not_below_start: Idle power threshold must be below the start power threshold.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already configured.

init.title: Washer options
init.description: Saving reloads the washer. A cycle already running starts its trace over.

data_description.start_power_threshold: A cycle starts when average power over 20 seconds reaches this value, or 20 W if this is lower
data_description.idle_power_threshold: Power below this value can end a cycle. Must be below the start threshold
data_description.end_delay: How long power must stay idle before the cycle ends
data_description.door_closed_start: A cycle starts only while the door is closed
data_description.tts_entity: Speaks the message when the wash finishes. Needs speakers too
data_description.notify_services: Notify services such as notify.mobile_app_phone. Sent when the wash finishes, also during quiet hours
data_description.announce_message: Spoken and pushed when the wash finishes
data_description.repeat_minutes: Minutes between spoken reminders until the door opens. 0 speaks once. Stops after 6 announcements
data_description.quiet_enabled: No speech during quiet hours. Push notifications still arrive. Speech waits until quiet hours end if the door is still closed
data_description.quiet_start: Quiet hours begin at this time
data_description.quiet_end: Quiet hours end at this time

error.idle_not_below_start: Idle power threshold must be below the start power threshold.
error.tts_incomplete: Choose both a text-to-speech service and at least one speaker, or neither.
error.invalid_notify_service: Each push service must look like notify.mobile_app_phone.
error.quiet_hours_empty: Quiet hours start and end must be different.

learn_start.name: Start learning
learn_start.description: Arm learning. The next full wash cycle is stored under this name. The same name on a later cycle refines the saved program.

program_name.name: Program name
program_name.description: Name to store this cycle under.

learn_cancel.name: Cancel learning
learn_cancel.description: Disarm learning and drop the trace recorded so far.
